== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Stormcallers are a cult dedicated to the [[Weeping Dragon]], one of the [[Dreadgods]]. They function as followers of [[Reigan Shen]] and are characterized by their use of lightning-based [[madra]]. Members often display [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]] in the form of crackling, scripted rings around their arms or biceps. This unique power is derived from harvesting the [[madra]] of the [[Weeping Dragon]] itself, which imbues them with a portion of the entity's animating will and [[hunger]]. Their combat techniques involve summoning blue-and-gold lightning, creating serpentine dragon constructions of [[madra]], and utilizing specialized abilities like the [[Harbinger of the Storm]] to manipulate wind, water, and lightning across a battlefield. The sect travels via a large storm cloud that serves as a mobile base, featuring various structures built directly upon it. While the group lacks a [[Herald]], they possess a [[Sage]] known as the [[Sage of Calling Storms]]. The cult is noted for its ability to capture and train individuals, such as [[Therian Nills]], and has been known to engage in brutal combat, including the mutilation of opponents' spirits.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Stormcallers are a [[Dreadgod cult]] that follows the entity to utilize its divine techniques for stealing [[madra]]. This group, which includes [[Calan Archer]], travels upon a massive storm cloud that produces rain. They employ lightning [[dragons]] capable of transporting [[madra]] back to their users and serve as one of the many factions surrounding the valley. While the organization possesses a [[Sage]], they currently have no [[Herald]].}}
